set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { var b = vars.pois default [] --- if ((b is Object) or (b is Array)) b else [] }]
set-variable.doc:name: pois (object or array, else [])

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.poi.response", tool: vars.toolName default "get_property_details", correlationId: vars.traceId, propertyCode: vars.request.propertyCode, empty: isEmpty(vars.pois)}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.poi.unavailable", tool: vars.toolName default "get_property_details", correlationId: vars.traceId, propertyCode: vars.request.propertyCode, status: error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default null, errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier, detail: error.description, body: do { var b = (if (error.errorMessage.payload is String) error.errorMessage.payload else write(error.errorMessage.payload default "", "application/json", {indent: false})) as String --- if (sizeOf(b) > 1000) b[0 to 999] else b }, nearby: "[] (response continues)"}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.poi.unavailable", tool: vars.toolName default "get_property_details", correlationId: vars.traceId, errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier, note: "POI error body not readable", nearby: "[] (response continues)"}, "application/json", {indent: false})]
logger.doc:name: poi.unavailable (no body)

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.poi.skipped", correlationId: vars.traceId, reason: "maxPois is 0"}, "application/json", {indent: false})]
